newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linde says H1 grp pre-tax profit up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Linde says H1 grp pre-tax profit up 8 pct.

text.p: Group orders in hand 6,357 up 3.1 pct

NOTE - Full name of the German diversified engineering group is Linde AG. Analyst forecasts for Linde's first half profit ranged from 270 million marks to more than 300 million, or an increase of 11 to 20 percent. Forecasts for first-half sales ranged from 3.9 billion marks to 4.05 billion marks.

The group said its business was satisfactory overall in the period despite weak domestic demand. The rise in sales would have been 10.2 percent discounting its plant construction division. Cargo handling equipment and refrigeration technology showed satisfactory rates of growth, Linde said. The rise in staff was due to the consolidation of four small foreign units.
